/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import re
import time
import urllib.request

values = []
for _ in range(2):
    before = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
    with urllib.request.urlopen('http://localhost:3100/') as response:
        html = response.read().decode()
        assert response.status == 200
    after = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
    assert '<nav>Operations</nav>' in html
    assert '<aside>Loading request details…</aside>' in html
    html = html.replace('<"'!-- -->'"', '')
    match = re.search(r'<aside>Request ([0-9a-f-]+) generated at (["'^<]+) '"\\(sample (["'^)]+)'"\\)</aside>', html)
    assert match, 'request metadata missing from response'
    request_id, generated_at, sample = match.groups()
    assert before <= datetime.fromisoformat(generated_at.replace('Z', '+00:00')) <= after
    values.append((request_id, generated_at, sample))
    time.sleep(0.02)

assert values[0][0] "'!= values[1][0], '"'request identifiers were reused'
assert values[0][1] "'!= values[1][1], '"'timestamps were reused'
assert values[0][2] "'!= values[1][2], '"'sampling values were reused'
print('Navigation and fallback present in both responses.')
print('Request 1:', values[0])
print('Request 2:', values[1])
PY"
